notes: Qwen3.8-27B (EXL3 3.0bpw mix) on the Ferrite 27B engine (--engine ferrite), one RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 24 GB, one slot of 131072; Qwen XML tool-call format (<tool_call><function=..><parameter=..>), reasoning in reasoning_content. The server closes a reasoning block at 8192 tokens, has a loop breaker (exact cycles and repeated sentences), never returns a stop token first, and applies the model card's per-mode sampling to the fields a client omits (sampling_profiles below; reported in the x-sampling-effective response header); a client that sends temperature 0 gets no penalty from the profile (greedy_keeps_fast_path).
